name: Oscillating Diffuser Volumetric Display
definition: A 360-degree display using a moving projection surface (vertically oscillating diffuser) synchronized with a projection system. It relies on retinal persistence to create a full volumetric object.
summary: An oscillating diffuser volumetric display creates 360-degree volumetric images using a vertically moving screen and projection, distinguished by its linear motion and lack of true occlusion.
